claim: A multi-stage reasoning pipeline comprising parsing, search, and confirmation stages progressively improves navigation performance in aerial vision-and-dialog navigation tasks.
falsifier: One could implement a similar multi-stage pipeline and measure navigation performance metrics (e.g., success rate, path length) on aerial navigation benchmarks, comparing against single-stage baselines.

exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system, task, population, and conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Multi-stage reasoning pipeline for navigation performance

claim: Instruction fine-tuning induces substantially more forgetting than preference optimization, while DPO is comparatively conservative and can partially recover losses.

conditions: Fixed datasets without model-specific hyperparameter tuning
Evaluation across multiple model families and domains
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported model families, domains, and post-training algorithms; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Post-training algorithm: instruction fine-tuning for Amount of…

claim: The area theorem imposes an upper bound on the efficiency of converting black hole mass into radiated energy during black hole collisions: the total horizon area after the collision is always greater than the sum of the initial individual horizon areas.
falsifier: The bound can be tested by simulating black hole mergers in general relativity and comparing the final horizon area to the sum of initial areas.

conditions: Matter obeys the null energy condition
exclusions: Limited to general relativity and classical matter satisfying the null energy condition

title: Area theorem–Upper bound on energy boundary
